[Econometrics · Monte Carlo Simulation]{.eyebrow}

### Evaluating the Confidence-Interval Performance of the Double LASSO Estimator

Finite-sample inference for Double LASSO in high-dimensional linear models.

- **Method:** Monte Carlo simulations across Gaussian, heavy-tailed, and approximately sparse data-generating processes, evaluating coverage, interval length, bias, and RMSE.
- **Findings:** Plug-in penalties deliver near-nominal coverage; heavy tails widen intervals; OLS becomes unstable as dimensionality approaches the sample size.
- **Tools:** Python, Quarto

[View repository on GitHub](https://github.com/mrshohruh/Double_Lasso)
:::

[Research Tools · Housing Economics]{.eyebrow}

### Uzbekistan Housing Market Research Agent

An autonomous research agent that turns raw housing data into a complete market and policy report.

- **Method:** Ingests JSON, SQL, CSV, Excel, or live database inputs; infers column semantics in English, Russian, and Uzbek; computes cross-sectional and time-series statistics (growth, seasonality, structural breaks, regional convergence); identifies drivers via correlation and multivariate OLS; and researches the policy and macroeconomic context.
- **Output:** A 13-section Word report with charts, tables, a dated policy timeline, and evidence-based recommendations. Runs fully offline or with Claude for narrative synthesis.
- **Tools:** Python, pandas, Streamlit, Anthropic Claude API

[View repository on GitHub](https://github.com/mrshohruh/Economic-Research-Agent)
:::
